name: Gigapede
description: A gigapede is a multi-legged monstrosity covered in red chitin that offers it significant protection. These creatures typically live in caves and tunnels of their own making, nurturing eggs that take nearly 200 years to hatch.

actions.name: Gaseous Expulsion
actions.description: The gigapede spews forth a pool of acid in a location within 8 units with a radius of 2 units, dealing poison damage.

actions.name: Volatile Spittle
actions.description: The gigapede launches a small, flaming sphere at a pool of spittle created by the Gaseous Expulsion action, igniting it and dealing unavoidable fire damage to any creature within the area.

actions.name: Vicious Bite
actions.description: The gigapede bites a creature, dealing physical damage. If the damage from this attack brings a character to 0 health, they make their lifeline check with a 1d4 penalty.

actions.name: Tail Thrash
actions.description: Immediately after using the Vicious Bite action, the gigapede makes a thrashing attack with it's tail against a different target, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the creature is knocked prone.

actions.name: Emergence
actions.description: While burrowed, the gigapede bursts from the ground and creates a shockwave, knocking creatures within a 3 unit radius prone.

actions.name: Mandibles
actions.description: The gigapede makes an attack with it's mandibles, dealing physical damage. On a true hit, the target must make a resilience check against half the total damage or gain 1 tier of the wounded condition.

actions.name: Attack of Opportunity
actions.description: In response to a creature leaving it's area of control, the gigapede makes an attack with it's Mandibles action.

traits.name: Acidic Blood
traits.description: The gigapede has acidic blood that can burn through iron within minutes. When this creature takes damage from the bleeding condition, all adjacent creatures also take the damage.

traits.name: Gaseous Reserves
traits.description: The gigapede has a limited amount of gas that can be used for it's Gaseous Expulsion action. After using the action for the first time, roll a 1d4 to determine how many charges remain. The gas is recharged after an hour.
